editorial.blurb: A consistently excellent BBQ destination where the smoky meats and welcoming staff create an experience that transcends typical counter-service—sit down, relax, and soak it in.
editorial.insiderTip: Skip the to-go option and claim a spot at the community tables to fully appreciate the experience; arrive early to avoid the long lines, and order the brisket if you want to see why it's earned Midwest acclaim.
